# AmneziaWG for MikroTik (amneziawg-mikrotik)

> Open-source (MIT) AmneziaWG client for MikroTik routers. It runs as a RouterOS 7 container
> (arm64, arm/v7, amd64/CHR), has a web UI, and sends the whole LAN, selected devices or selected
> sites through an AmneziaWG (Amnezia VPN) tunnel. Russian: «AmneziaWG на MikroTik», «Amnezia VPN на микротике».

RouterOS's built-in WireGuard client cannot connect to AmneziaWG servers, because AmneziaWG adds junk
packets and changes packet headers. amneziawg-mikrotik runs the full userspace client (amneziawg-go) in a
container, so all AmneziaWG options, including AWG 2.0 (S3, S4, I1–I5, header ranges), work unchanged.

Key facts:
- Configure with a `vpn://` key from the Amnezia app, a `.conf` file, or SSH credentials of an Amnezia
  server (the container creates its own client there, like the Amnezia app does).
- The web UI writes RouterOS routing rules, mangle rules, address lists, kill switch and DNS through the
  RouterOS REST API; the router login is not stored.
- Country exceptions (e.g. `ru`) let subnets of chosen countries bypass the tunnel.
- Several saved servers, one-click switching, automatic failover to a backup server in ~15 s.
- Image about 10 MB, about 8 MB RAM. Supported: hAP ax², hAP ax³, RB5009, CCR2004, Chateau ax, hAP ac²,
  hAP ac³, RB4011, cAP ac, CHR. Not supported: mipsbe/mmips routers (hAP lite, hEX).
- Not affiliated with Amnezia VPN or MikroTik.

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/amneziawg-mikrotik/blob/main/README.md): features, build, HTTP API
- [README (Русский)](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/amneziawg-mikrotik/blob/main/README.ru.md): описание и FAQ на русском
- [MikroTik setup guide](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/amneziawg-mikrotik/blob/main/docs/mikrotik-setup.md): step-by-step RouterOS commands, DNS, IPv6, troubleshooting

## Downloads

- Container image (multi-arch, for RouterOS `remote-image=`): `ghcr.io/namikko-chad/amneziawg-mikrotik` and [Docker Hub `namikko/amneziawg-mikrotik`](https://hub.docker.com/r/namikko/amneziawg-mikrotik)
- [Releases](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/amneziawg-mikrotik/releases): RouterOS-importable `.tar` images per architecture
- [Source code](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/amneziawg-mikrotik)
